name: Immich
description: Photo and video counts, storage used and the job queue of your Immich server on cards.
author: TheMightyTRexUK

settings.label: Immich's address
settings.hint: Such as http://192.0.2.10:2283, without /api on the end.

settings.label: API key
settings.hint: Made in Immich under Account settings, API keys. Give it only the permissions server.statistics, server.storage and queue.read (job.read for an older Immich). Starboard never shows it again.

items.title: The disk Immich is on
items.detail: 1.2 TB used of 4.0 TB (30%), 2.8 TB free

added: **Three cards for Immich:** how many photos and videos, where the space goes and how full the disk is, and what the job queues are doing.
**Failed jobs** are said on the jobs card, so a stuck queue does not hide.
**Light:** it runs only when a card asks, keeps each answer for a minute, and rests five minutes after; nothing at rest.
**You choose** the address and an API key with only the permissions it needs.
